verdict.rationale: Assigning a custom identifier or alias to a model is a fair question for a local model-serving runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents aliasing, renaming, or custom identifiers for loaded models. The pack mentions only a general REST API for running and managing models and the ability to switch models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
